integrity: The proof was reconstructed from the focal paper's detector estimate, finite-support recovery lemma, and quantitative selection argument. The fixed lacunarity ratio was replaced by a free parameter \(s>1\), both geometric tails were estimated with their relative boundary positions, and the limit \(G_s\to1\) was checked symbolically. No finite experiment or independent certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The proof requires \(0<p<q\le1\) and does not cover \(q=p\). It does not determine or prove optimality of \(\Gamma_p\). For noncompact bases the quantitative conclusion is limited to bounded separated sets with Kalton's property.
title: A \(q\)-uniform \(\Gamma_p\) strong Schur bound for compact Lipschitz-free \(p\)-spaces
